title: Hard Shadow Button
summary: A solid offset shadow that collapses as the button is pushed into it.
description: The press moves the button by exactly the shadow offset, so the two visually meet — the detail most hard-shadow buttons get wrong.
accessibility_notes: Use a real <button>; keep a visible :focus-visible ring and never rely on hover alone to convey state. Motion stops under prefers-reduced-motion.
variations: Bigger offset for a bolder look
Add a border for full neubrutalism
ai_usage: Neubrutalist and indie-product UIs. Set translate on :active to the same value as the shadow offset and drop the shadow to 0 — mismatched values make the button look like it floats after the press.
source:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
  <title>Hard Shadow Button</title>
  <script type="application/json" id="effect-meta">
  {
    "id": "depth-shadow-button",
    "title": "Hard Shadow Button",
    "summary": "A solid offset shadow that collapses as the button is pushed into it.",
    "description": "The press moves the button by exactly the shadow offset, so the two visually meet — the detail most hard-shadow buttons get wrong.",
    "theme": "buttons",
    "categories": ["button", "press"],
    "tags": ["neubrutalism", "hard-shadow", "press", "offset", "tactile"],
    "tech": ["css"],
    "era": "2020s",
    "difficulty": "beginner",
    "dependencies": [],
    "browser_support": "All modern browsers (Chromium, Firefox, Safari).",
    "performance_notes": "Lightweight — composited transform/opacity work only.",
    "accessibility_notes": "Use a real <button>; keep a visible :focus-visible ring and never rely on hover alone to convey state. Motion stops under prefers-reduced-motion.",
    "customization": [
      { "name": "--c", "description": "Button color", "default": "#fbbf24" },
      { "name": "--sh", "description": "Shadow color", "default": "#0b0d12" },
      { "name": "--off", "description": "Shadow offset", "default": "6px" }
    ],
    "variations": ["Colored shadow instead of black", "Bigger offset for a bolder look", "Add a border for full neubrutalism"],
    "ai_usage": "Neubrutalist and indie-product UIs. Set translate on :active to the same value as the shadow offset and drop the shadow to 0 — mismatched values make the button look like it floats after the press."
  }
  </script>
  <style>
    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
    html, body { height: 100%; margin: 0; }
    body { display: grid; place-items: center; background: #0b0d12; color: #e7ebf3;
      font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif; overflow: hidden; }
    button { font: inherit; cursor: pointer; border: 0; }
    button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7c5cff; outline-offset: 3px; }
    :root { --c: #fbbf24; --sh: #0b0d12; --off: 6px; }
    .hard { padding: .95rem 2.2rem; border: 3px solid var(--sh); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--c);
      color: var(--sh); font-weight: 800; box-shadow: var(--off) var(--off) 0 var(--sh); transition: transform .1s, box-shadow .1s; }
    .hard:active { transform: translate(var(--off), var(--off)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 var(--sh); }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      * { animation: none !important; transition: none !important; }
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <button class="hard" type="button">Click it</button>
</body>
</html>
